steps.message: You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

Please solve this issue: We're building backend for a helpdesk SaaS for businesses and their customers.
Use Rails in API-only mode; the frontend is a separate app.
Ruby, Rails, Puma, and PostgreSQL are installed. If you need anything else, install it yourself.
Use `DATABASE_URL`. Work in `/app`.

The owner needs help. Add an `agent` role and let admins invite other admins or agents:

```http
POST /api/v1/invitations

{"invitation":{"email":"sam@example.test","role":"agent"}}
```

Return an `invitation` and email a link to `/accept-invitation?account=acme&token=TOKEN` on the
frontend. Let admins list and inspect invitations, resend them with `POST /invitations/:id/resend`,
and revoke them with `DELETE /invitations/:id`. Track pending, accepted, revoked, and expired
invitations. Don't create competing invitations or let customer registration take a pending invite's email.
List invitations by ID ascending.

The acceptance screen uses `POST /invitation_previews` with
`{"invitation_preview":{"token":"TOKEN"}}` to show the invited email, role, business name, subdomain,
and expiry inside `invitation_preview`. Then it submits:

```http
POST /api/v1/invitation_acceptances

{"invitation_acceptance":{"token":"TOKEN","name":"Sam","password":"my-team-password"}}
```

Return `user` and `account`; Sam can sign in without another verification email.

Admins also need `GET /users`, `GET /users/:id`, and `PATCH /users/:id`. Include `suspended` on users
and support `{"user":{"suspended":true}}`. Suspension revokes sessions and clears assignments.
Don't let admins suspend the last active admin. Filter users by role or suspension, and invitations
by status. `GET /staff` supplies active staff choices for assignment controls.
List users and staff by ID ascending.

Staff can assign tickets with `{"ticket":{"assignee_id":12}}` or clear them with null. Include
`assignee_id` and the assignee's ID/name on tickets. Both admins and agents can work on the business's
tickets, but only admins manage people.

Add private notes through the existing comment input, for example
`{"ticket":{"comment":{"body":"Checking this with billing.","public":false}}}`.
Internal activity must not change the customer-facing request.

require_relative "helpdesk_config"

class CorsMiddleware
  DEFAULT_ALLOW_METHODS = "GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS, HEAD"
  DEFAULT_ALLOW_HEADERS = %w[Authorization Content-Type X-Helpdesk-Account Accept].freeze
  MAX_AGE = "7200"

  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
  end

  def call(env)
    origin = env["HTTP_ORIGIN"]
    origin_allowed = !origin.nil? && !origin.empty? && origin == HelpdeskConfig.frontend_origin

    if env["REQUEST_METHOD"] == "OPTIONS"
      return handle_preflight(env, origin, origin_allowed)
    end

    status, headers, body = @app.call(env)
    append_vary_origin(headers)

    if origin_allowed
      headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = origin
    end

    [ status, headers, body ]
  end

  private

  def handle_preflight(env, origin, origin_allowed)
    unless origin_allowed
      return [ 403, { "Vary" => "Origin" }, [] ]
    end

    requested_headers = env["HTTP_ACCESS_CONTROL_REQUEST_HEADERS"].to_s
      .split(",")
      .map(&:strip)
      .reject(&:empty?)

    merged_headers = DEFAULT_ALLOW_HEADERS.dup
    requested_headers.each do |header|
      merged_headers << header unless merged_headers.any? { |h| h.casecmp?(header) }
    end

    headers = {
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" => origin,
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods" => DEFAULT_ALLOW_METHODS,
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers" => merged_headers.join(", "),
      "Access-Control-Max-Age" => MAX_AGE,
      "Vary" => "Origin"
    }

    [ 204, headers, [] ]
  end

  def append_vary_origin(headers)
    existing_key = headers.keys.find { |k| k.downcase == "vary" }
    if existing_key
      values = headers[existing_key].to_s.split(",").map(&:strip)
      unless values.any? { |v| v.casecmp?("Origin") }
        headers[existing_key] = (values + [ "Origin" ]).join(", ")
      end
    else
      headers["Vary"] = "Origin"
    end
  end
end

require "cgi"
require "uri"

module HelpdeskConfig
  DEFAULT_FRONTEND_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
  DEFAULT_MAIL_FROM = "support@example.test"

  module_function

  def frontend_url
    url = ENV["HELPDESK_FRONTEND_URL"]
    url = DEFAULT_FRONTEND_URL if url.nil? || url.strip.empty?
    url.strip.chomp("/")
  end

  def frontend_origin
    uri = URI.parse(frontend_url)
    return frontend_url unless uri.scheme && uri.host

    default_port = (uri.scheme == "https" ? 443 : 80)
    if uri.port && uri.port != default_port
      "#{uri.scheme}://#{uri.host}:#{uri.port}"
    else
      "#{uri.scheme}://#{uri.host}"
    end
  rescue URI::InvalidURIError
    frontend_url
  end

  def mail_from
    sender = ENV["HELPDESK_MAIL_FROM"]
    sender = DEFAULT_MAIL_FROM if sender.nil? || sender.strip.empty?
    sender.strip
  end

    "#{frontend_url}/verify-email?account=#{CGI.escape(account.subdomain)}&token=#{CGI.escape(token)}"

require "digest"
require "securerandom"

class UserToken < ApplicationRecord
  EMAIL_VERIFICATION = "email_verification"
  PASSWORD_RESET = "password_reset"
  PURPOSES = [ EMAIL_VERIFICATION, PASSWORD_RESET ].freeze
  TTL = {
    EMAIL_VERIFICATION => 24.hours,
    PASSWORD_RESET => 2.hours
  }.freeze

  belongs_to :account
  belongs_to :user

  validates :purpose, presence: true, inclusion: { in: PURPOSES }
  validates :token_digest, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :expires_at, presence: true

  scope :for_purpose, ->(purpose) { where(purpose: purpose) }
  scope :active, -> { where("expires_at > ?", Time.current) }

  def self.digest(raw_token)
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(raw_token.to_s)
  end

  def self.issue_for!(user:, purpose:)
    raw_token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
    transaction do
      user.user_tokens.for_purpose(purpose).delete_all
      create!(
        account: user.account,
        user: user,
        purpose: purpose,
        token_digest: digest(raw_token),
        expires_at: TTL.fetch(purpose).from_now
      )
    end
    raw_token
  end

  def self.find_valid(account:, purpose:, raw_token:)
    return nil if account.nil? || raw_token.blank?

    includes(:user, :account)
      .for_purpose(purpose)
      .active
      .find_by(account_id: account.id, token_digest: digest(raw_token))
  end
end

module Api
  module V1
    class AccountsController < BaseController
      before_action :resolve_account!, except: :create
      before_action :authenticate_user!, except: :create
      before_action :require_active_account!, only: [ :show, :cancel ]
      before_action :require_owner!, only: [ :cancel, :reactivate ]

      def create
        account_envelope = require_object_param(:account)
        admin_envelope = require_object_param(:admin, source: account_envelope)

        account = Account.new(account_envelope.permit(:name, :subdomain))
        user = account.users.build(admin_envelope.permit(:name, :email, :password, :password_confirmation))
        user.role = "admin"

        account_valid = account.valid?
        user_valid = user.valid?

        unless account_valid && user_valid
          errors = {}
          account.errors.messages.each { |k, v| errors[k.to_s] = v }
          user.errors.messages.each { |k, v| errors["admin.#{k}"] = v }
          render json: {
            error: (account.errors.full_messages + user.errors.full_messages).first || "Validation failed",
            errors: errors
          }, status: :unprocessable_content
          return
        end

        verification_token = nil
        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          account.save!
          user.account = account
          user.save!
          account.update!(owner: user)
          verification_token = UserToken.issue_for!(user: user, purpose: UserToken::EMAIL_VERIFICATION)
        end

        AuthMailer.email_verification(user: user, token: verification_token).deliver_now

        render json: {
          account: serialize_account(account),
          user: serialize_user(user)
        }, status: :created
      rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
        render json: {
          error: "Subdomain has already been taken",
          errors: { subdomain: [ "has already been taken" ] }
        }, status: :unprocessable_content

        render json: { account: serialize_account(current_account) }, status: :ok

        unless current_account.reactivatable?
          render json: { error: "Account can no longer be reactivated after 90 days" }, status: :unprocessable_content

class TicketTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  test "normalizes subject, defaults to open, and validates status and account ownership" do
    acme = Account.create!(name: "Acme", subdomain: "acme")
    beta = Account.create!(name: "Beta", subdomain: "beta")
    customer = acme.users.create!(name: "Avery", email: "avery@example.test", password: "my-customer-password", role: "customer")

    ticket = acme.tickets.create!(requester: customer, subject: "  Cannot download receipt  ")
    assert_equal "Cannot download receipt", ticket.subject
    assert_equal "open", ticket.status

    invalid_status = acme.tickets.build(requester: customer, subject: "Test", status: "closed")
    assert_not invalid_status.valid?
    assert invalid_status.errors[:status].any?

    blank_subject = acme.tickets.build(requester: customer, subject: "   ")
    assert_not blank_subject.valid?
    assert blank_subject.errors[:subject].any?

    cross_account = acme.tickets.build(requester: beta_customer, subject: "Cross tenant")
    assert_not cross_account.valid?
    assert cross_account.errors[:requester].any?
  end

  test "comment creation touches ticket updated_at and purge_cancelled! deletes tickets and comments" do
    old_account = Account.create!(name: "Old", subdomain: "old", cancelled_at: 91.days.ago)
    owner = old_account.users.create!(name: "Jo", email: "jo@old.test", password: "my-first-password", role: "admin", email_verified_at: 100.days.ago)
    old_account.update!(owner: owner)
    customer = old_account.users.create!(name: "Avery", email: "avery@old.test", password: "my-customer-password", role: "customer", email_verified_at: 100.days.ago)

    ticket = nil
    travel_to Time.zone.parse("2026-01-01 10:00:00 UTC") do
      ticket = old_account.tickets.create!(requester: customer, subject: "Receipt issue")
    end

    original_updated_at = ticket.updated_at

    travel_to Time.zone.parse("2026-01-01 10:05:00 UTC") do
      Comment.create!(account: old_account, ticket: ticket, author: owner, body: "Checking now", public: true)

    assert_equal 0, Ticket.where(account_id: old_account.id).count
    assert_equal 0, Comment.where(account_id: old_account.id).count
  end

**Deep Dive into Invitation Management**

Okay, here's the game plan. We need to build out this invitation system meticulously, so let's break down everything the prompt throws at us. First, we're adding the "agent" role. This means we'll need to define that role in our `User` model, along with the existing "admin" and "customer" roles. We're keeping these as constants.

We're going to set up a robust authorization matrix. Admins will be able to invite agents and other admins, but who has access to what endpoint is crucial, and we need to map that out. Only admins manage people, so only admins can create, list, inspect, resend, and revoke invitations (endpoints 403 otherwise).

The `invitations` table is the heart of this system. We're storing details like the `account_id`, `invited_by_id` (who sent the invite), the email, the role being invited, a hashed `token_digest` (never raw tokens in the DB!), `expires_at`, `accepted_at`, `revoked_at`, and `accepted_user_id`. We'll use database constraints to ensure data integrity and prevent race conditions.

Now, let's nail down the state transitions. We need to track `pending`, `accepted`, `revoked`, and `expired` statuses.  The state is derived dynamically based on `accepted_at`, `revoked_at`, and how `expires_at` compares to the current time. The important insight here is that *only* the `pending` state should be active, meaning it's the only one that can be modified. Think about an expired invite. We *must not* allow it to be resent or revoked; otherwise, you'd have a collision with new accounts and other invitations, which could cause massive bugs.

-   **Creating Invitations:** When we get a `POST /api/v1/invitations` request, we need to handle validations carefully. The email must be valid, normalized, and not already associated with a user in the current account (also handle for multi-tenant accounts). This includes not allowing competing pending invitations for the same email. We'll protect against race conditions using a database transaction with account locks.
-   **Resending Invitations:** `POST /api/v1/invitations/:id/resend` is only allowed for *pending* invitations.  This generates a new token (rotating the `token_digest`), updates `expires_at`, and sends out a new email. Expired, accepted, or revoked invitations cannot be resent, and if we allow it, it will cause race conditions with account signups.
-   **Revoking Invitations:**  `DELETE /api/v1/invitations/:id` transitions the invitation to "revoked". This should return `200 OK` with the serialized invitation, not `204 No Content` because we still have the invitation in the database with its updated status. We're keeping the invites around for auditing and filtering.

We need to make sure the state machine for invitations is bulletproof, with clean logic and no race conditions.

require "cgi"
require "uri"

module HelpdeskConfig
  DEFAULT_FRONTEND_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
  DEFAULT_MAIL_FROM = "support@example.test"

  module_function

  def frontend_url
    url = ENV["HELPDESK_FRONTEND_URL"]
    url = DEFAULT_FRONTEND_URL if url.nil? || url.strip.empty?
    url.strip.chomp("/")
  end

  def frontend_origin
    uri = URI.parse(frontend_url)
    return frontend_url unless uri.scheme && uri.host

    default_port = (uri.scheme == "https" ? 443 : 80)
    if uri.port && uri.port != default_port
      "#{uri.scheme}://#{uri.host}:#{uri.port}"
    else
      "#{uri.scheme}://#{uri.host}"
    end
  rescue URI::InvalidURIError
    frontend_url
  end

  def mail_from
    sender = ENV["HELPDESK_MAIL_FROM"]
    sender = DEFAULT_MAIL_FROM if sender.nil? || sender.strip.empty?
    sender.strip
  end

  def verification_url(account:, token:)
    "#{frontend_url}/verify-email?account=#{CGI.escape(account.subdomain)}&token=#{CGI.escape(token)}"
  end

  def password_reset_url(account:, token:)
    "#{frontend_url}/reset-password?account=#{CGI.escape(account.subdomain)}&token=#{CGI.escape(token)}"
  end

  def invitation_url(account:, token:)
    "#{frontend_url}/accept-invitation?account=#{CGI.escape(account.subdomain)}&token=#{CGI.escape(token)}"
  end
end
EOF

The `sync_suspended_at` callback is spot-on for keeping the `suspended_at` timestamp consistent. The scopes look efficient and well-defined. I'll need to double-check the logic of `active?`, `clear_assigned_tickets!`, and `revoke_all_sessions!`.

Moving to `Invitation`, I see the defined roles and statuses. I need to make sure the inclusion validation for `role` uses `INVITABLE_ROLES`. The normalization of email is a smart touch. I'll need to review the validations, especially related to the `invited_by_belongs_to_account` and `accepted_user_belongs_to_account`. The scopes, particularly `pending` and `expired`, seem essential. I'm going to pay close attention to the class and instance methods, especially around token generation and status determination. I'll review how fresh tokens are assigned and revoked to make sure there are no security holes.

The `Ticket` model has the appropriate associations, and the lifecycle callbacks for timestamp management look reasonable. I should make sure the scopes are appropriate for the anticipated use cases.

Now, `Comment` has a straightforward association. I can see the need to touch the ticket's timestamps, and the conditional update based on public visibility is a good implementation detail. **Wait, wait, wait... I need to spend time on the ticket validation!** The `assignee_must_be_active_staff_in_account` validation merits *very* close inspection. I'm concerned about cases where an `assignee_id` might be set but the `assignee` record itself is invalid or missing or suspended. In light of that, the implementation needs a bit of a tweak. I can see the possible problems: if `ticket.assignee_id` is set, and the `assignee` is invalid, or the assignee does not belong to the account, the validation must fail. I can quickly rewrite the validation as a clear set of conditional checks: first, check that *both* `assignee_id` and `assignee` are present; if there is an `assignee`, validate account membership, then ensure the role is a staff role and make sure the assignee is not suspended.

class Account < ApplicationRecord
  CANCELLED_RETENTION_PERIOD = 90.days
  SUBDOMAIN_FORMAT = /\A[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\z/

  belongs_to :owner, class_name: "User", optional: true
  has_many :comments, dependent: :delete_all
  has_many :tickets, dependent: :delete_all
  has_many :invitations, dependent: :delete_all
  has_many :sessions, dependent: :delete_all
  has_many :user_tokens, dependent: :delete_all
  has_many :users, dependent: :destroy

  normalizes :name, with: ->(value) { value.strip }
  normalizes :subdomain, with: ->(value) { value.strip.downcase }

  validates :name, presence: true, length: { maximum: 255 }
  validates :subdomain,
    presence: true,
    uniqueness: { case_sensitive: false },
    format: {
      with: SUBDOMAIN_FORMAT,
      message: "must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens, and cannot start or end with a hyphen"
    }
  validate :owner_belongs_to_account

  before_destroy :clear_owner_reference

  scope :active, -> { where(cancelled_at: nil) }
  scope :cancelled, -> { where.not(cancelled_at: nil) }
  scope :purgeable, ->(as_of = Time.current) { cancelled.where("cancelled_at <= ?", as_of - CANCELLED_RETENTION_PERIOD) }

  def self.purge_cancelled!(as_of = Time.current)
    purged_count = 0
    purgeable(as_of).find_each do |account|
      account.destroy!
      purged_count += 1
    end
    purged_count
  end

  def active?
    cancelled_at.nil?
  end

  def cancelled?
    cancelled_at.present?
  end

  def owner?(user)
    user.present? && owner_id.present? && owner_id == user.id
  end

  def reactivatable?(as_of = Time.current)
    cancelled? && cancelled_at > as_of - CANCELLED_RETENTION_PERIOD
  end

  def cancel!
    transaction do
      update!(cancelled_at: Time.current)
      sessions.delete_all
    end
  end

  def reactivate!
    update!(cancelled_at: nil)
  end

  private

  def clear_owner_reference
    update_column(:owner_id, nil) if persisted? && owner_id.present?
  end

  def owner_belongs_to_account
    return if owner.nil? || id.nil?

    if owner.account_id != id
      errors.add(:owner, "must belong to this account")
    end
  end
end
EOF

require "digest"

class Invitation < ApplicationRecord
  INVITABLE_ROLES = %w[admin agent].freeze
  PENDING = "pending"
  ACCEPTED = "accepted"
  REVOKED = "revoked"
  EXPIRED = "expired"
  STATUSES = [ PENDING, ACCEPTED, REVOKED, EXPIRED ].freeze
  TTL = 7.days

  belongs_to :account
  belongs_to :invited_by, class_name: "User", optional: true, inverse_of: :sent_invitations
  belongs_to :accepted_user, class_name: "User", optional: true, inverse_of: :accepted_invitations

  scope :pending, ->(as_of = Time.current) { where(accepted_at: nil, revoked_at: nil).where("expires_at > ?", as_of) }

    end
  end

  def self.digest(raw_token)
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(raw_token.to_s)
  end

  def self.generate_raw_token
    SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
  end

  def self.find_pending(account:, raw_token:)
    return nil if account.nil? || raw_token.blank?

    includes(:account, :invited_by)
      .pending
      .find_by(account_id: account.id, token_digest: digest(raw_token))
  end

  def status(as_of = Time.current)
    if accepted_at.present?
      ACCEPTED
    elsif revoked_at.present?
      REVOKED
    elsif expires_at.present? && expires_at <= as_of
      EXPIRED
    else
      PENDING
    end
  end

  def pending?(as_of = Time.current)
    status(as_of) == PENDING
  end

  def accepted?
    accepted_at.present?
  end

  def revoked?
    accepted_at.nil? && revoked_at.present?
  end

  def expired?(as_of = Time.current)
    status(as_of) == EXPIRED
  end

  def assign_fresh_token!
    raw_token = self.class.generate_raw_token
    self.token_digest = self.class.digest(raw_token)
    self.expires_at = TTL.from_now
    raw_token
  end

  def resend!
    raw_token = assign_fresh_token!
    save!
    raw_token
  end

  def revoke!
    update!(revoked_at: Time.current)
  end

  private

  def invited_by_belongs_to_account
    return if invited_by.nil? || account_id.nil?

    if invited_by.account_id != account_id
      errors.add(:invited_by, "must belong to this account")
    end
  end

  def accepted_user_belongs_to_account
    return if accepted_user.nil? || account_id.nil?

    if accepted_user.account_id != account_id
      errors.add(:accepted_user, "must belong to this account")
    end
  end
end
EOF

  OPEN = "open"

  SOLVED = "solved"

  belongs_to :account
  belongs_to :requester, class_name: "User", inverse_of: :requested_tickets
  belongs_to :assignee, class_name: "User", optional: true, inverse_of: :assigned_tickets
  has_many :comments, dependent: :delete_all, inverse_of: :ticket

  normalizes :subject, with: ->(value) { value.strip }

  validates :subject, presence: true, length: { maximum: 255 }
  validates :status, presence: true, inclusion: { in: STATUSES }
  validate :requester_belongs_to_account
  validate :assignee_must_be_active_staff_in_account

  before_create :initialize_customer_updated_at
  before_update :refresh_customer_updated_at, if: :customer_facing_attribute_changed?

  scope :recently_active, -> { order(updated_at: :desc, id: :desc) }
  scope :recently_active_for_customer, -> { order(customer_updated_at: :desc, id: :desc) }
  scope :for_requester, ->(user) { where(requester_id: user.id) }

  private

  def customer_facing_attribute_changed?
    will_save_change_to_status? || will_save_change_to_subject?
  end

  def initialize_customer_updated_at
    now = current_time_from_proper_timezone
    self.created_at ||= now
    self.updated_at ||= now
    self.customer_updated_at ||= self.updated_at
  end

  def refresh_customer_updated_at
    now = current_time_from_proper_timezone
    self.updated_at = now unless will_save_change_to_updated_at?
    self.customer_updated_at = self.updated_at
  end

  def requester_belongs_to_account
    return if requester.nil? || account_id.nil?

    if requester.account_id != account_id
      errors.add(:requester, "must belong to this account")
    end
  end

  def assignee_must_be_active_staff_in_account
    return if assignee_id.nil? && assignee.nil?

    if assignee.nil?
      errors.add(:assignee_id, "must be an active staff member of this account")
    elsif account_id.present? && assignee.account_id != account_id
      errors.add(:assignee_id, "must belong to this account")
    elsif !assignee.staff?
      errors.add(:assignee_id, "must be a staff member")

Alright, let's break down these controller changes systematically. As a seasoned developer, I'm focusing on potential vulnerabilities, edge cases, and the overall robustness of these modifications.

1.  **`BaseController` Updates**:

    *   The `authenticate_user!` method now includes a crucial check for suspended users, immediately destroying their session and rendering a 401 error. This is a solid security measure.
    *   The addition of `require_admin!` enforces administrative privileges, preventing unauthorized actions.
    *   The `serialize_*` methods have been enhanced to provide consistent and informative data serialization across different user types (user, staff, invitations). I especially like that `iso8601` is being used to prevent timezone issues. The updates to the serialization methods seem comprehensive. The ticket serialization adds the `requester` and `assignee` details.

2.  **`SessionsController` Enhancement**:

    *   An additional check within the `SessionsController` prevents suspended users from logging in, providing an informative 403 error.

3.  **`RegistrationsController` Improvements**:

    *   The revised registration process within a database lock ( `with_lock` ) incorporates email validation and ensures an email is not duplicated if it has a pending invitation.
    *   The separate delivery of the verification email outside the database lock is a key optimization. It prevents the email sending from blocking the registration.

4.  **`RequestsController` and `TicketsController` Adjustments**:

    *   The `RequestsController` now only returns recently active tickets for customers.
    *   `TicketsController`'s `index` and `show` actions now eagerly load associated requester and assignee data, improving performance and reducing database queries.
    *   I've reviewed the assignee handling logic. The validation, and strict parsing of the `assignee_id` are essential to prevent any security issues. The use of `parse_strict_positive_id` for sanitizing integer input and avoiding injection vulnerabilities is a good practice.
    *   The code reloads the ticket after updates ensuring that any calculated fields, or data such as the `updated_at` timestamps, are fresh.
    *   The assignee updates handle the edge case where the ticket is invalid but the `assignee_id` has been sent.

5.  **`InvitationsController` Enhancements**:

    *   The `InvitationsController` includes robust input validation and authorization using `before_action`, ensuring security and integrity.
    *   Comprehensive validation prevents the creation of duplicate invitations and handles various email-related scenarios effectively.
    *   The `create`, `resend`, and `destroy` actions are designed to manage the invitation lifecycle securely within the database lock.
    *   The mailing of the invitations is done outside the database locks which is an excellent design choice.
    *   I've paid attention to the strict validation of email and role fields, preventing invalid input and potential errors.

6.  **`InvitationPreviewsController` Addition**:

    *   This new controller provides a secure way to preview an invitation's details, using a token to prevent unauthorized access.

7.  **`InvitationAcceptancesController` Addition**:

    *   This controller handles the acceptance of invitations, including secure password handling. All data updates within a database lock, and the logic correctly handles any email-taken errors, preventing race conditions.
    *   I’ve double-checked the password handling for various inputs, including blank and short passwords, and made sure that validation correctly detects invalid password input.
    *   The data updates are wrapped within the database lock and this prevents race conditions and ensures data integrity.

8.  **`UsersController` Enhancements**:

    *   Robust input validation has been implemented to handle role, suspended status, and other parameters.
    *   The `update` action includes safeguards to prevent the suspension of the last active admin, and to revoke user sessions, as well as clear assigned tickets when a user is suspended.
    *   I’ve carefully checked that `suspend` and `name` are correctly handled and validated, ensuring the action is secure and reliable, preventing accidental administrative lockouts.

9.  **`StaffController` Addition**:

    *   This controller provides a secure way to retrieve a list of active staff members, using authorization and data serialization.

Overall, the implemented modifications show a thorough understanding of security, performance, and data integrity. I'm satisfied with the thought that went into each change.

module Api
  module V1
    class BaseController < ApplicationController
      DEFAULT_PAGE = 1
      DEFAULT_PER_PAGE = 25
      MAX_PER_PAGE = 100

      rescue_from ActionController::ParameterMissing do |e|
        render json: { error: e.message }, status: :bad_request
      end

      rescue_from ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, ActiveModel::RangeError do
        render json: { error: "Not found" }, status: :not_found
      end

      private

      attr_reader :current_account, :current_session, :current_user

      def resolve_account!
        subdomain = request.headers["X-Helpdesk-Account"].to_s.strip.downcase
        if subdomain.blank?
          render json: { error: "Missing X-Helpdesk-Account header" }, status: :bad_request
          return
        end

        @current_account = Account.find_by(subdomain: subdomain)
        if @current_account.nil?
          render json: { error: "Account not found" }, status: :not_found
        end
      end

      def authenticate_user!
        token = extract_bearer_token
        if token.blank?
          render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        @current_session = Session.authenticate(account: current_account, raw_token: token)
        if @current_session.nil?
          render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        @current_user = @current_session.user
        if @current_user.suspended?
          @current_session.destroy
          render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end
      end

      def require_active_account!
        if current_account.cancelled?
          render json: { error: "Account is cancelled" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_owner!
        unless current_account.owner?(current_user)
          render json: { error: "Only the account owner can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_admin!
        unless current_user.admin?
          render json: { error: "Only admins can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_staff!
        unless current_user.staff?
          render json: { error: "Only staff can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_customer!
        unless current_user.customer?
          render json: { error: "Only customers can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def extract_bearer_token
        auth_header = request.headers["Authorization"].to_s
        match = auth_header.match(/\ABearer\s+(\S+)\z/i)
        match ? match[1] : nil
      end

      def require_object_param(key, source: params)
        value = source.require(key)
        unless value.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
          raise ActionController::ParameterMissing.new(key)
        end
        value
      end

      def extract_optional_comment_param(envelope)
        return nil unless envelope.key?(:comment)

        value = envelope[:comment]
        return nil if value.nil?

        unless value.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
          raise ActionController::ParameterMissing.new(:comment)
        end

        value
      end

      def parse_positive_int(raw, default:)
        return default if raw.blank?

        value = Integer(raw.to_s.strip, 10)
        value >= 1 ? value : default
      rescue ArgumentError, TypeError
        default
      end

      def parse_strict_positive_id(value)
        if value.is_a?(Integer)
          value > 0 ? value : nil
        elsif value.is_a?(String) && value.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
          value.to_i
        end
      end

      def pagination_params
        page = parse_positive_int(params[:page], default: DEFAULT_PAGE)
        per_page = [ parse_positive_int(params[:per_page], default: DEFAULT_PER_PAGE), MAX_PER_PAGE ].min
        [ page, per_page ]
      end

      def paginate(relation)
        page, per_page = pagination_params
        count = relation.count
        total_pages = (count.to_f / per_page).ceil
        offset = (page - 1) * per_page

        records = if count == 0 || offset >= count
                    []
                  else
                    relation.limit(per_page).offset(offset).to_a
                  end

        next_page = page < total_pages ? page + 1 : nil
        previous_page = if page <= 1 || total_pages == 0
                          nil
                        else
                          [ page - 1, total_pages ].min
                        end

        {
          records: records,
          meta: {
            count: count,
            page: page,
            per_page: per_page,
            next_page: next_page,
            previous_page: previous_page
          }
        }
      end

      def serialize_portal(account)
        {
          name: account.name,
          subdomain: account.subdomain
        }
      end

      def serialize_account(account)
        {
          id: account.id,
          name: account.name,
          subdomain: account.subdomain,
          status: account.cancelled? ? "cancelled" : "active",
          cancelled_at: account.cancelled_at&.iso8601,
          created_at: account.created_at.iso8601,
          updated_at: account.updated_at.iso8601
        }
      end

      def serialize_user(user)
        {
          id: user.id,
          account_id: user.account_id,
          name: user.name,
          email: user.email,
          role: user.role,
          verified: user.verified?,
          email_verified_at: user.email_verified_at&.iso8601,
          suspended: user.suspended?,
          suspended_at: user.suspended_at&.iso8601,
          created_at: user.created_at.iso8601,
          updated_at: user.updated_at.iso8601
        }
      end

      def serialize_staff_member(user)
        {
          id: user.id,
          name: user.name,
          email: user.email,
          role: user.role
        }
      end

      def serialize_invitation(invitation)
        {
          id: invitation.id,
          account_id: invitation.account_id,
          email: invitation.email,
          role: invitation.role,
          status: invitation.status,
          invited_by_id: invitation.invited_by_id,
          invited_by: invitation.invited_by ? {
            id: invitation.invited_by.id,
            name: invitation.invited_by.name
          } : nil,
          expires_at: invitation.expires_at.iso8601,
          accepted_at: invitation.accepted_at&.iso8601,
          revoked_at: invitation.revoked_at&.iso8601,
          created_at: invitation.created_at.iso8601,
          updated_at: invitation.updated_at.iso8601
        }
      end

      def serialize_invitation_preview(invitation)
        {
          email: invitation.email,
          role: invitation.role,
          account_name: invitation.account.name,
          subdomain: invitation.account.subdomain,
          account: {
            name: invitation.account.name,
            subdomain: invitation.account.subdomain
          },
          expires_at: invitation.expires_at.iso8601
        }
      end

      def serialize_session(session)
        {
          id: session.id,
          token: session.raw_token,
          created_at: session.created_at.iso8601,
          updated_at: session.updated_at.iso8601
        }
      end

      def serialize_request(ticket)
        {
          id: ticket.id,
          subject: ticket.subject,
          status: ticket.status,
          requester_id: ticket.requester_id,
          created_at: ticket.created_at.iso8601,
          updated_at: ticket.customer_updated_at.iso8601
        }
      end

      def serialize_ticket(ticket)
        {
          id: ticket.id,
          subject: ticket.subject,
          status: ticket.status,
          requester_id: ticket.requester_id,
          requester: {
            id: ticket.requester.id,
            name: ticket.requester.name,
            email: ticket.requester.email
          },
          assignee_id: ticket.assignee_id,
          assignee: ticket.assignee ? {
            id: ticket.assignee.id,
            name: ticket.assignee.name
          } : nil,
          created_at: ticket.created_at.iso8601,
          updated_at: ticket.updated_at.iso8601
        }
      end

      def serialize_comment(comment)
        {
          id: comment.id,
          body: comment.body,
          public: comment.public,
          author: {
            id: comment.author.id,
            name: comment.author.name
          },
          created_at: comment.created_at.iso8601
        }
      end

      def render_validation_errors(record)
        render json: {
          error: record.errors.full_messages.first || "Validation failed",
          errors: record.errors.messages
        }, status: :unprocessable_content
      end

      def render_ticket_and_comment_errors(ticket, comment = nil)
        errors = {}
        full_messages = []

        ticket.errors.messages.each { |k, v| errors[k.to_s] = v }
        full_messages.concat(ticket.errors.full_messages)

        if comment
          comment.errors.messages.each { |k, v| errors["comment.#{k}"] = v }
          comment.errors.full_messages.each { |msg| full_messages << "Comment #{msg.downcase}" }
        end

        render json: {
          error: full_messages.first || "Validation failed",
          errors: errors
        }, status: :unprocessable_content
      end
    end
  end
end

module Api
  module V1
    class SessionsController < BaseController
      before_action :resolve_account!
      before_action :authenticate_user!, only: :destroy

      def create
        session_params = require_object_param(:session).permit(:email, :password)
        email = session_params[:email].to_s.strip.downcase
        password = session_params[:password].to_s

        user = current_account.users.find_by(email: email)
        if user.nil? || !user.authenticate(password)
          render json: { error: "Invalid email or password" }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        unless user.verified?
          render json: { error: "Email address must be verified before signing in" }, status: :forbidden
          return
        end

        if user.suspended?
          render json: { error: "User account is suspended" }, status: :forbidden
          return
        end

        if current_account.cancelled? && !current_account.owner?(user)
          render json: { error: "Account is cancelled" }, status: :forbidden
          return
        end

        session = Session.issue_for!(user)

        render json: {
          session: serialize_session(session),
          user: serialize_user(user),
          account: serialize_account(current_account)
        }, status: :created
      end

      def destroy
        current_session.destroy!
        head :no_content
      end
    end
  end
end

module Api
  module V1
    class RegistrationsController < BaseController
      before_action :resolve_account!
      before_action :require_active_account!

      def create
        user_params = require_object_param(:user).permit(:name, :email, :password, :password_confirmation)

        user = current_account.users.build(user_params)
        user.role = "customer"

        verification_token = nil
        created = false

        current_account.with_lock do
          user_valid = user.valid?

          if user.email.present? && user.errors[:email].empty? && current_account.invitations.pending.exists?(email: user.email)
            user.errors.add(:email, "already has a pending invitation")
            user_valid = false
          end

          if user_valid
            user.save!
            verification_token = UserToken.issue_for!(user: user, purpose: UserToken::EMAIL_VERIFICATION)
            created = true
          end
        end

        unless created
          render_validation_errors(user)
          return
        end

        AuthMailer.email_verification(user: user, token: verification_token).deliver_now

        render json: { user: serialize_user(user) }, status: :created
      rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
        render json: {
          error: "Email has already been taken",
          errors: { email: [ "has already been taken" ] }
        }, status: :unprocessable_content
      end
    end
  end

module Api
  module V1
    class RequestsController < BaseController
      before_action :resolve_account!
      before_action :authenticate_user!
      before_action :require_active_account!
      before_action :require_customer!

      def index
        relation = customer_tickets.recently_active_for_customer
        result = paginate(relation)

        render json: {
          requests: result[:records].map { |ticket| serialize_request(ticket) }
        }.merge(result[:meta]), status: :ok
      end

      def show
        ticket = find_customer_ticket!
        render json: { request: serialize_request(ticket) }, status: :ok
      end

      def create
        request_envelope = require_object_param(:request)
        comment_envelope = extract_optional_comment_param(request_envelope)

        ticket = current_account.tickets.build(
          requester: current_user,
          subject: request_envelope.permit(:subject)[:subject],
          status: Ticket::OPEN
        )
        comment = Comment.new(
          account: current_account,
          ticket: ticket,
          author: current_user,
          body: comment_envelope&.permit(:body)&.[](:body),
          public: true
        )

        ticket_valid = ticket.valid?
        comment_valid = comment.valid?

        unless ticket_valid && comment_valid
          render_ticket_and_comment_errors(ticket, comment)
          return
        end

        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          ticket.save!
          comment.save!
        end

        render json: { request: serialize_request(ticket.reload) }, status: :created
      end

      def update
        ticket = find_customer_ticket!
        request_envelope = require_object_param(:request)
        comment_envelope = extract_optional_comment_param(request_envelope)

        comment = if comment_envelope
                    Comment.new(
                      account: current_account,
                      ticket: ticket,
                      author: current_user,
                      body: comment_envelope.permit(:body)[:body],
                      public: true
                    )
                  end

        invalid_status_message = nil
        if request_envelope.key?(:status)
          requested_status = request_envelope[:status]
          if requested_status == Ticket::SOLVED
            ticket.status = Ticket::SOLVED
          else
            invalid_status_message = "can only be set to solved"
          end
        elsif comment.present? && [ Ticket::PENDING, Ticket::SOLVED ].include?(ticket.status)
          ticket.status = Ticket::OPEN
        end

        ticket_valid = ticket.valid?
        if invalid_status_message
          ticket.errors.add(:status, invalid_status_message)
          ticket_valid = false
        end

        comment_valid = comment.nil? || comment.valid?

        unless ticket_valid && comment_valid
          render_ticket_and_comment_errors(ticket, comment)
          return
        end

        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          ticket.save! if ticket.changed?
          comment.save! if comment.present?
        end

        render json: { request: serialize_request(ticket.reload) }, status: :ok
      end

      def comments
        ticket = find_customer_ticket!
        relation = ticket.comments.visible_to_customers.chronological.includes(:author)
        result = paginate(relation)

        render json: {
          comments: result[:records].map { |comment| serialize_comment(comment) }
        }.merge(result[:meta]), status: :ok
      end

      private

      def customer_tickets
        current_account.tickets.for_requester(current_user)
      end

      def find_customer_ticket!
        customer_tickets.find(params[:id])
      end
    end
  end
end

        ticket_envelope = require_object_param(:ticket)
        comment_envelope = extract_optional_comment_param(ticket_envelope)

        invalid_status_message = nil
        if ticket_envelope.key?(:status)
          requested_status = ticket_envelope[:status]
          if requested_status.is_a?(String) && Ticket::STATUSES.include?(requested_status)
            ticket.status = requested_status
          else
            invalid_status_message = "is not included in the list"
          end
        end

        invalid_assignee_message = nil
        if ticket_envelope.key?(:assignee_id)
          raw_assignee_id = ticket_envelope[:assignee_id]
          if raw_assignee_id.nil?
            ticket.assignee = nil
          else
            parsed_id = parse_strict_positive_id(raw_assignee_id)
            if parsed_id.nil?
              invalid_assignee_message = "must be an active staff member of this account"
            else
              candidate = begin
                current_account.users.find_by(id: parsed_id)
              rescue ActiveModel::RangeError
                nil
              end

              if candidate.nil? || !candidate.staff? || candidate.suspended?
                invalid_assignee_message = "must be an active staff member of this account"
              else
                ticket.assignee = candidate
              end
            end
          end
        end

        comment = nil
        public_invalid = false
        if comment_envelope
          is_public = true
          if comment_envelope.key?(:public)
            if [ true, false ].include?(comment_envelope[:public])
              is_public = comment_envelope[:public]
            else
              public_invalid = true
            end
          end

          comment = Comment.new(
            account: current_account,
            ticket: ticket,
            author: current_user,
            body: comment_envelope.permit(:body)[:body],
            public: is_public
          )
        end

        ticket_valid = ticket.valid?
        if invalid_status_message
          ticket.errors.add(:status, invalid_status_message)
          ticket_valid = false
        end
        if invalid_assignee_message
          ticket.errors.add(:assignee_id, invalid_assignee_message)
          ticket_valid = false
        end

        comment_valid = true
        if comment
          comment_valid = comment.valid?
          if public_invalid
            comment.errors.add(:public, "must be a boolean")
            comment_valid = false
          end
        end

        unless ticket_valid && comment_valid
          render_ticket_and_comment_errors(ticket, comment)
          return
        end

        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          ticket.save! if ticket.changed?
          comment.save! if comment.present?
        end

        reloaded_ticket = current_account.tickets.includes(:requester, :assignee).find(ticket.id)
        render json: { ticket: serialize_ticket(reloaded_ticket) }, status: :ok
      end

        }.merge(result[:meta]), status: :ok

          unless Invitation::STATUSES.include?(requested_status)
            render json: {
              error: "Status is not included in the list",
              errors: { status: [ "is not included in the list" ] }
            }, status: :unprocessable_content
            return
          end
          relation = relation.with_status(requested_status)
        end

        result = paginate(relation)

        render json: {
          invitations: result[:records].map { |invitation| serialize_invitation(invitation) }
        }.merge(result[:meta]), status: :ok
      end

      def show
        invitation = current_account.invitations.includes(:invited_by).find(params[:id])
        render json: { invitation: serialize_invitation(invitation) }, status: :ok
      end

      def create
        invitation_envelope = require_object_param(:invitation)
        raw_email = invitation_envelope[:email]
        raw_role = invitation_envelope[:role]

        invitation = current_account.invitations.build(
          invited_by: current_user,
          email: raw_email.is_a?(String) ? raw_email : nil,
          role: raw_role.is_a?(String) ? raw_role : nil
        )
        raw_token = invitation.assign_fresh_token!

        created = false
        current_account.with_lock do
          invitation_valid = invitation.valid?

          if raw_email.present? && !raw_email.is_a?(String)
            invitation.errors.add(:email, "is invalid") unless invitation.errors[:email].include?("is invalid")
            invitation_valid = false
          end

          if raw_role.present? && !raw_role.is_a?(String)
            invitation.errors.add(:role, "is not included in the list") unless invitation.errors[:role].include?("is not included in the list")
            invitation_valid = false
          end

          if invitation.email.present? && invitation.errors[:email].empty?
            if current_account.users.exists?(email: invitation.email)
              invitation.errors.add(:email, "has already been taken")
              invitation_valid = false
            elsif current_account.invitations.pending.exists?(email: invitation.email)
              invitation.errors.add(:email, "already has a pending invitation")
              invitation_valid = false
            end
          end

          if invitation_valid
            invitation.save!
            created = true
          end
        end

        unless created
          render_validation_errors(invitation)
          return
        end

        AuthMailer.invitation(invitation: invitation, token: raw_token).deliver_now

        render json: { invitation: serialize_invitation(invitation) }, status: :created
      end

      def resend
        invitation = nil
        raw_token = nil
        error_message = nil

        current_account.with_lock do
          invitation = current_account.invitations.includes(:invited_by).find(params[:id])
          if invitation.pending?
            raw_token = invitation.resend!
          else
            error_message = "Only pending invitations can be resent"
          end
        end

        if error_message
          render json: { error: error_message }, status: :unprocessable_content
          return
        end

        AuthMailer.invitation(invitation: invitation, token: raw_token).deliver_now

        render json: { invitation: serialize_invitation(invitation) }, status: :ok
      end

      def destroy
        invitation = nil
        error_message = nil

        current_account.with_lock do
          invitation = current_account.invitations.includes(:invited_by).find(params[:id])
          if invitation.pending?
            invitation.revoke!
          else
            error_message = "Only pending invitations can be revoked"
          end
        end

        if error_message
          render json: { error: error_message }, status: :unprocessable_content
          return
        end

        render json: { invitation: serialize_invitation(invitation) }, status: :ok
      end
    end
  end
end
EOF

require "test_helper"

class InvitationTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  test "validates fields, normalizes email, tracks statuses, and enforces account ownership" do
    acme = Account.create!(name: "Acme", subdomain: "acme")
    beta = Account.create!(name: "Beta", subdomain: "beta")
    acme_admin = acme.users.create!(name: "Jo", email: "jo@acme.test", password: "my-first-password", role: "admin")
    beta_admin = beta.users.create!(name: "Bo", email: "bo@beta.test", password: "my-first-password", role: "admin")

    inv = acme.invitations.build(invited_by: acme_admin, email: "  Sam@Example.Test  ", role: "agent")
    raw_token = inv.assign_fresh_token!
    inv.save!

    assert_equal "sam@example.test", inv.email
    assert_equal Invitation::PENDING, inv.status
    assert inv.pending?
    assert_not inv.accepted?
    assert_not inv.revoked?
    assert_not inv.expired?
    assert_equal inv, Invitation.find_pending(account: acme, raw_token: raw_token)
    assert_nil Invitation.find_pending(account: beta, raw_token: raw_token)

    # Customer role is not invitable
    customer_inv = acme.invitations.build(invited_by: acme_admin, email: "c@example.test", role: "customer")
    customer_inv.assign_fresh_token!
    assert_not customer_inv.valid?
    assert customer_inv.errors[:role].any?

    # Cross-account inviter is rejected
    cross_inv = acme.invitations.build(invited_by: beta_admin, email: "x@example.test", role: "agent")
    cross_inv.assign_fresh_token!
    assert_not cross_inv.valid?
    assert cross_inv.errors[:invited_by].any?

    # Expired status
    travel Invitation::TTL + 1.minute do
      assert_equal Invitation::EXPIRED, inv.status
      assert inv.expired?
      assert_not inv.pending?
      assert_nil Invitation.find_pending(account: acme, raw_token: raw_token)
      assert_equal [ inv.id ], acme.invitations.expired.pluck(:id)
      assert_equal [], acme.invitations.pending.pluck(:id)
    end

    # Revoked stays revoked even after expiry
    inv.revoke!
    assert_equal Invitation::REVOKED, inv.status
    assert inv.revoked?
    travel Invitation::TTL + 1.day do
      assert_equal Invitation::REVOKED, inv.status
      assert_equal [ inv.id ], acme.invitations.revoked.pluck(:id)
      assert_equal [], acme.invitations.expired.pluck(:id)
    end

    # Accepted stays accepted even after expiry
    inv2 = acme.invitations.build(invited_by: acme_admin, email: "pat@example.test", role: "admin")
    inv2.assign_fresh_token!
    inv2.save!
    inv2.update!(accepted_at: Time.current)
    assert_equal Invitation::ACCEPTED, inv2.status
    travel Invitation::TTL + 1.day do
      assert_equal Invitation::ACCEPTED, inv2.status
      assert_equal [ inv2.id ], acme.invitations.accepted.pluck(:id)
    end
  end

  test "purge_cancelled! deletes account invitations cleanly" do
    old_account = Account.create!(name: "Old", subdomain: "old", cancelled_at: 91.days.ago)
    owner = old_account.users.create!(name: "Jo", email: "jo@old.test", password: "my-first-password", role: "admin", email_verified_at: 100.days.ago)
    old_account.update!(owner: owner)

    inv = old_account.invitations.build(invited_by: owner, email: "sam@old.test", role: "agent")
    inv.assign_fresh_token!
    inv.save!

    assert_equal 1, Account.purge_cancelled!
    assert_equal 0, Invitation.where(account_id: old_account.id).count
  end
end
EOF

    agent = acme.users.create!(name: "Sam", email: "sam@acme.test", password: "my-team-password", role: "agent")
    suspended_agent = acme.users.create!(name: "Pat", email: "pat@acme.test", password: "my-team-password", role: "agent", suspended: true)
    customer = acme.users.create!(name: "Avery", email: "avery@acme.test", password: "my-customer-password", role: "customer")
    beta_admin = beta.users.create!(name: "Bo", email: "bo@beta.test", password: "my-first-password", role: "admin")

    ticket = acme.tickets.create!(requester: customer, subject: "Help")

    assert ticket.update(assignee: admin)
    assert ticket.update(assignee: agent)
    assert ticket.update(assignee: nil)

    assert_not ticket.update(assignee: customer)
    assert ticket.errors[:assignee_id].any?

    assert_not ticket.update(assignee: suspended_agent)
    assert ticket.errors[:assignee_id].any?

    assert_not ticket.update(assignee: beta_admin)
    assert ticket.errors[:assignee_id].any?
  end

  test "comment creation touches ticket updated_at and private/internal activity leaves customer_updated_at unchanged" do
    old_account = Account.create!(name: "Old", subdomain: "old", cancelled_at: 91.days.ago)

    old_account.update!(owner: owner)
    customer = old_account.users.create!(name: "Avery", email: "avery@old.test", password: "my-customer-password", role: "customer", email_verified_at: 100.days.ago)

    ticket = nil
    travel_to Time.zone.parse("2026-01-01 10:00:00 UTC") do
      ticket = old_account.tickets.create!(requester: customer, subject: "Receipt issue")
    end

    original_updated_at = ticket.updated_at
    assert_equal original_updated_at, ticket.customer_updated_at

    # Internal assignment does not touch customer_updated_at
    travel_to Time.zone.parse("2026-01-01 10:02:00 UTC") do
      ticket.update!(assignee: owner)
    end
    ticket.reload
    assert_operator ticket.updated_at, :>, original_updated_at
    assert_equal original_updated_at, ticket.customer_updated_at

    travel_to Time.zone.parse("2026-01-01 10:03:00 UTC") do

    end

    assert_operator ticket.updated_at, :>, after_assign
    assert_equal original_updated_at, ticket.customer_updated_at

    # Public comment touches both updated_at and customer_updated_at
    travel_to Time.zone.parse("2026-01-01 10:05:00 UTC") do

    end

    assert_operator ticket.updated_at, :>, original_updated_at
    assert_equal ticket.updated_at, ticket.customer_updated_at

    assert_equal 1, Account.purge_cancelled!
    assert_not Account.exists?(old_account.id)
    assert_equal 0, Ticket.where(account_id: old_account.id).count
    assert_equal 0, Comment.where(account_id: old_account.id).count
  end

  test "resend rotates token and extends expiry; revoke and expiry track all four statuses and filter by status in ID ascending order" do
    signup_and_verify!
    owner_token = sign_in!["session"]["token"]
    base_time = Time.zone.parse("2026-06-01 12:00:00 UTC")

    inv_accepted_id = nil
    inv_revoked_id = nil
    inv_expired_id = nil
    inv_pending_id = nil
    revoked_token = nil
    expired_token = nil
    pending_token_1 = nil
    pending_token_2 = nil

    travel_to base_time do
      # 1. Accepted invitation
      accepted_res = invite_and_accept!(admin_token: owner_token, email: "accepted@example.test", role: "agent", name: "Acc")
      inv_accepted_id = accepted_res[:invitation]["id"]

      # 2. Revoked invitation
      create_invitation(token: owner_token, email: "revoked@example.test", role: "agent")
      assert_response :created
      inv_revoked_id = json_body["invitation"]["id"]
      revoked_token = extract_token_from_mail(ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last, path: "/accept-invitation")[:token]

      delete "/api/v1/invitations/#{inv_revoked_id}", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token)
      assert_response :ok
      assert_equal "revoked", json_body["invitation"]["status"]
      assert json_body["invitation"]["revoked_at"].present?

      # Revoked invitation token fails preview and acceptance; cannot resend or revoke again
      post "/api/v1/invitation_previews",
        params: { invitation_preview: { token: revoked_token } },
        headers: account_headers("acme"),
        as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content

      post "/api/v1/invitation_acceptances",
        params: { invitation_acceptance: { token: revoked_token, name: "Rev", password: "my-team-password" } },
        headers: account_headers("acme"),
        as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content

      post "/api/v1/invitations/#{inv_revoked_id}/resend", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token), as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content

      delete "/api/v1/invitations/#{inv_revoked_id}", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token)
      assert_response :unprocessable_content

      # 3. Will expire invitation
      create_invitation(token: owner_token, email: "expired@example.test", role: "admin")
      assert_response :created
      inv_expired_id = json_body["invitation"]["id"]
      expired_token = extract_token_from_mail(ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last, path: "/accept-invitation")[:token]
    end

    # 4. Pending invitation created 2 days later, then resent 1 day after that
    initial_pending_expiry = nil
    travel_to base_time + 2.days do
      create_invitation(token: owner_token, email: "pending@example.test", role: "agent")
      assert_response :created
      inv_pending_id = json_body["invitation"]["id"]
      initial_pending_expiry = Time.iso8601(json_body["invitation"]["expires_at"])
      pending_token_1 = extract_token_from_mail(ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last, path: "/accept-invitation")[:token]
    end

    travel_to base_time + 3.days do
      ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.clear
      post "/api/v1/invitations/#{inv_pending_id}/resend", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token), as: :json
      assert_response :ok
      assert_equal 1, ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.size
      assert_operator Time.iso8601(json_body["invitation"]["expires_at"]), :>, initial_pending_expiry

      pending_token_2 = extract_token_from_mail(ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last, path: "/accept-invitation")[:token]
      assert_not_equal pending_token_1, pending_token_2

      # Old token is invalidated immediately
      post "/api/v1/invitation_previews",
        params: { invitation_preview: { token: pending_token_1 } },
        headers: account_headers("acme"),
        as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content

      # New token works for preview
      post "/api/v1/invitation_previews",
        params: { invitation_preview: { token: pending_token_2 } },
        headers: account_headers("acme"),
        as: :json
      assert_response :ok
      assert_equal "pending@example.test", json_body["invitation_preview"]["email"]
    end

    # At base_time + 8 days: inv_expired is expired, inv_pending (resent at +3 days, expires +10 days) is still pending!
    travel_to base_time + 8.days do
      # Expired token rejected for preview, acceptance, resend, revoke
      post "/api/v1/invitation_previews",
        params: { invitation_preview: { token: expired_token } },
        headers: account_headers("acme"),
        as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content

      post "/api/v1/invitation_acceptances",
        params: { invitation_acceptance: { token: expired_token, name: "Exp", password: "my-team-password" } },
        headers: account_headers("acme"),
        as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content

      post "/api/v1/invitations/#{inv_expired_id}/resend", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token), as: :json
      assert_response :unprocessable_content

      delete "/api/v1/invitations/#{inv_expired_id}", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token)
      assert_response :unprocessable_content

      # List all invitations by ID ascending
      get "/api/v1/invitations", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token)
      assert_response :ok
      assert_equal [ inv_accepted_id, inv_revoked_id, inv_expired_id, inv_pending_id ],
        json_body["invitations"].map { |i| i["id"] }
      assert_equal %w[accepted revoked expired pending],
        json_body["invitations"].map { |i| i["status"] }
      assert_equal 4, json_body["count"]

      # Pagination works in ID ascending order
      get "/api/v1/invitations?page=2&per_page=2", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token)
      assert_response :ok
      assert_equal [ inv_expired_id, inv_pending_id ], json_body["invitations"].map { |i| i["id"] }
      assert_equal 1, json_body["previous_page"]
      assert_nil json_body["next_page"]

      # Filter by each status
      {
        "accepted" => [ inv_accepted_id ],
        "revoked" => [ inv_revoked_id ],
        "expired" => [ inv_expired_id ],
        "pending" => [ inv_pending_id ]
      }.each do |status, expected_ids|
        get "/api/v1/invitations?status=#{status}", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token)
        assert_response :ok
        assert_equal expected_ids, json_body["invitations"].map { |i| i["id"] }, "Failed status filter #{status}"
        assert_equal expected_ids.size, json_body["count"]
      end

      # Invalid status filter rejected
      get "/api/v1/invitations?status=bogus", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_token)
      assert_response :unprocessable_content
      assert json_body["errors"]["status"].present?
    end
  end

  test "prevents competing invitations and blocks customer registration for pending invite emails, allowing reuse after revoke or expiry" do
    signup_and_verify!(name: "Acme", subdomain: "acme", email: "jo@acme.test")
    signup_and_verify!(name: "Beta", subdomain: "beta", email: "jo@beta.test")
    register_and_verify_customer!(subdomain: "acme", name: "Avery", email: "avery@example.test")

    acme_token = sign_in!(subdomain: "acme", email: "jo@acme.test")["session"]["token"]
    beta_token = sign_in!(subdomain: "beta", email: "jo@beta.test")["session"]["token"]
    ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.clear

    # Cannot invite existing admin or existing customer or invalid role
    create_invitation(subdomain: "acme", token: acme_token, email: "JO@ACME.TEST", role: "agent")
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json_body["errors"]["email"].present?

    create_invitation(subdomain: "acme", token: acme_token, email: "avery@example.test", role: "agent")
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json_body["errors"]["email"].present?

    create_invitation(subdomain: "acme", token: acme_token, email: "new@example.test", role: "customer")
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json_body["errors"]["role"].present?
    assert_equal 0, ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.size

    # Invite Sam in Acme
    create_invitation(subdomain: "acme", token: acme_token, email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent")
    assert_response :created
    inv1_id = json_body["invitation"]["id"]

    # Competing invitation for same email (case-insensitive, even different role) rejected
    ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.clear
    create_invitation(subdomain: "acme", token: acme_token, email: "SAM@EXAMPLE.TEST", role: "admin")
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json_body["errors"]["email"].present?
    assert_equal 0, ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.size

    # Customer registration cannot take pending invite's email in Acme
    register_customer(subdomain: "acme", name: "Sneaky Sam", email: "SAM@EXAMPLE.TEST", password: "my-customer-password")
    assert_response :unprocessable_content
    assert json_body["errors"]["email"].present?
    assert_equal 0, ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.size

    # Multi-tenant: same email CAN be invited OR registered as customer in Beta!
    create_invitation(subdomain: "beta", token: beta_token, email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent")
    assert_response :created

    register_customer(subdomain: "beta", name: "Beta Sam", email: "other-sam@example.test", password: "my-customer-password")
    assert_response :created

    # Revoking Acme invite allows re-inviting OR customer registration in Acme
    delete "/api/v1/invitations/#{inv1_id}", headers: account_headers("acme", token: acme_token)
    assert_response :ok

    create_invitation(subdomain: "acme", token: acme_token, email: "sam@example.test", role: "admin")
    assert_response :created
    inv2_id = json_body["invitation"]["id"]
    assert_operator inv2_id, :>, inv1_id

    # After inv2 expires, both customer registration and re-inviting are allowed again
    travel Invitation::TTL + 1.hour do
      register_customer(subdomain: "acme", name: "Customer Sam", email: "sam@example.test", password: "my-customer-password")
      assert_response :created

      # Now that customer exists, inviting sam@example.test fails because user exists
      create_invitation(subdomain: "acme", token: acme_token, email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent")
      assert_response :unprocessable_content
      assert json_body["errors"]["email"].present?
    end
  end

  test "enforces admin-only authorization, multi-tenant isolation, and cancelled account blocking for invitations" do
    signup_and_verify!(name: "Acme", subdomain: "acme", email: "jo@acme.test")
    signup_and_verify!(name: "Beta", subdomain: "beta", email: "jo@beta.test")
    register_and_verify_customer!(subdomain: "acme", name: "Avery", email: "avery@example.test")

    acme_admin_token = sign_in!(subdomain: "acme", email: "jo@acme.test")["session"]["token"]
    beta_admin_token = sign_in!(subdomain: "beta", email: "jo@beta.test")["session"]["token"]
    customer_token = sign_in!(subdomain: "acme", email: "avery@example.test", password: "my-customer-password")["session"]["token"]

    invite_and_accept!(subdomain: "acme", admin_token: acme_admin_token, email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent", name: "Sam")
    agent_token = sign_in!(subdomain: "acme", email: "sam@example.test", password: "my-team-password")["session"]["token"]

    create_invitation(subdomain: "acme", token: acme_admin_token, email: "pending@example.test", role: "agent")
    assert_response :created
    inv_id = json_body["invitation"]["id"]
    inv_token = extract_token_from_mail(ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last, path: "/accept-invitation")[:token]

    # Unauthenticated -> 401
    get "/api/v1/invitations", headers: account_headers("acme")
    assert_response :unauthorized
    post "/api/v1/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: "x@example.test", role: "agent" } }, headers: account_headers("acme"), as: :json
    assert_response :unauthorized

    # Agent and customer -> 403 on all invitation management endpoints
    [ agent_token, customer_token ].each do |non_admin_token|
      get "/api/v1/invitations", headers: account_headers("acme", token: non_admin_token)
      assert_response :forbidden
      get "/api/v1/invitations/#{inv_id}", headers: account_headers("acme", token: non_admin_token)
      assert_response :forbidden
      create_invitation(subdomain: "acme", token: non_admin_token, email: "blocked@example.test", role: "agent")
      assert_response :forbidden
      post "/api/v1/invitations/#{inv_id}/resend", headers: account_headers("acme", token: non_admin_token), as: :json
      assert_response :forbidden
      delete "/api/v1/invitations/#{inv_id}", headers: account_headers("acme", token: non_admin_token)
      assert_response :forbidden
    end

    # Cross-tenant isolation: Beta admin cannot see, resend, or revoke Acme invitation
    get "/api/v1/invitations", headers: account_headers("beta", token: beta_admin_token)
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal [], json_body["invitations"]

    get "/api/v1/invitations/#{inv_id}", headers: account_headers("beta", token: beta_admin_token)
    assert_response :not_found
    post "/api/v1/invitations/#{inv_id}/resend", headers: account_headers("beta", token: beta_admin_token), as: :json
    assert_response :not_found
    delete "/api/v1/invitations/#{inv_id}", headers: account_headers("beta", token: beta_admin_token)
    assert_response :not_found

    # Cross-tenant preview and acceptance rejected
    post "/api/v1/invitation_previews",
      params: { invitation_preview: { token: inv_token } },
      headers: account_headers("beta"),
      as: :json
    assert_response :unprocessable_content

    post "/api/v1/invitation_acceptances",
      params: { invitation_acceptance: { token: inv_token, name: "Wrong Tenant", password: "my-team-password" } },
      headers: account_headers("beta"),
      as: :json
    assert_response :unprocessable_content

    # Cancelled account blocks invitation preview, acceptance, and management
    post "/api/v1/account/cancel", headers: account_headers("acme", token: acme_admin_token), as: :json
    assert_response :ok

    post "/api/v1/invitation_previews",
      params: { invitation_preview: { token: inv_token } },
      headers: account_headers("acme"),
      as: :json
    assert_response :forbidden

    post "/api/v1/invitation_acceptances",
      params: { invitation_acceptance: { token: inv_token, name: "Blocked", password: "my-team-password" } },
      headers: account_headers("acme"),
      as: :json
    assert_response :forbidden

    owner_cancelled_token = sign_in!(subdomain: "acme", email: "jo@acme.test")["session"]["token"]
    get "/api/v1/invitations", headers: account_headers("acme", token: owner_cancelled_token)
    assert_response :forbidden
  end
end

**Handling Whitespace in Ruby String Literals**

Alright, so I was just working with some Ruby code, and I ran into a bit of a gotcha with string literals and whitespace. My initial instinct was to use the `<<~RUBY` heredoc syntax. But then I remembered that `<<~RUBY` actually *strips* leading whitespace, which is fine in some cases, but not always. It depends on what the code I am creating does.
